_comment: You need to download the file locally so that the evaluator can verify whether the local file and the file in the VM are exactly identical. The current evaluator is too weak.
instruction: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open. Create a 1-hour Thunderbird Calendar event for 10:00 AM tomorrow titled `Physiotherapy Appointment`, with every item from the provided webpage's `Common Mistakes to Avoid` section copied exactly into the description.
gt_steps: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open.
Open the provided Incline Health webpage in Google Chrome.
Find the Common Mistakes to Avoid section.
Read all four listed common mistakes.
In the Calendars list, enable the Home calendar if it is disabled.
Determine tomorrow's date from the system date.
Create a 1-hour calendar event for tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
Copy all four common mistakes from the webpage into the event description without paraphrasing.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$osk = Get-Process -Name osk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 }; if ($osk) { Write-Output 'OSK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'OSK_NOT_OPEN' }"

rules.title: Physiotherapy Appointment
body_points: wearing restrictive clothes that limit movement
forgetting to bring referral letters or medical scans
arriving late, rushed, or anxious — take a few minutes beforehand to relax
holding back information about pain, medication, or past injuries
